paragraphs: Unqualified Rav Bibi seems somewhat to be bar Avin, but that man lived with Yochanan, unqualified Bibi with Abaye. In Abba bar Rav Huna’s name, Shekalim 1; Elazar’s name, Pesachim 72b; Zevachim 70b; Ma'aser Sheni 2, 5. Ivo and Huna from Yitzchak bar Marion; Ammi, see there. In Assi’s name, Shevuot 6b; Makkot 19b; Shabbat 14a, Rav Assi; see 74a. Before Yisa, Jerusalem Ta'anit, end of chapter 2. Dimi, see there; Zeira spoke to him, Pesachim 72b. Before Ze'ira, Ma'aser Sheni 5; Chizkiyah. In Chana’s name, Jerusalem Berakhot; Chanina’s, Kilayim 4, beginning of Shevi'it. Teraya. In Rav Yehudah’s name, Eruvin 23b; Yehoshua ben Levi’s, Berakhot 62b; Yochanan’s, Bava Kamma 61, end of a; Yose’s, Makkot 21b. Yitzchak bar Bisna spoke to him. Yitzchak, called Rish Galuta, was his sister’s son. Kohen bar Avin in his name. He asked Nachman, see above. In Reuven’s name, Jerusalem Sanhedrin 1; Midrash Shmuel 23; Ruth, “They took Moabite wives.” In Resh Lakish’s name, disagreement concerning wheat, etc.; Yirmeyah from Resh Lakish, disagreement in this, etc., Makkot 17a; Jerusalem Niddah 3.
